notes: Evaluates /cadence-parallel concurrency & tier invariants: separate cadence-explorer before cadence-spec-author, missing/invalid tier never defaults to Low, mandatory Step 3 integration-branch checkpoint before implementation worktrees, dependency hold until merged, no-op subagent never resumed, additive rebase conflict resolution, and post-review edit routing back to owning worktree.

evals.name: tier-routing-and-mandatory-checkpoint-before-worktrees
evals.prompt: Orchestrate parallel delivery for ACME-101 (High), ACME-109 (Low), and ACME-200 (tier: "").
evals.expected_output: Halts ACME-200 without defaulting empty tier to Low; routes ACME-109 straight past spec/maintainer (Code Review single gate); invokes cadence-explorer before cadence-spec-author on ACME-101; requires Gate 1 approval + Step 3 checkpoint merge into integration branch before spawning isolated implementation worktrees.
assertions: Pauses any ticket with missing/blank/invalid tier without defaulting to Low
Skips cadence-spec-author, cadence-architect, and cadence-maintainer for Low-tier tickets
Dispatches cadence-explorer before cadence-spec-author for Medium/High tickets
Enforces Step 3 checkpoint commit and integration-branch merge prior to creating isolated implementation worktrees

evals.name: noop-worktree-never-resumed-and-additive-rebase
evals.prompt: One worker exits without commits while another worker's branch conflicts on CHANGELOG.md after a sibling merged.
evals.expected_output: Never resumes a zero-change/no-op worktree subagent (spawns fresh worktree session); delegates rebase onto latest integration branch back to owning worktree context preserving both siblings' CHANGELOG entries, re-runs full tests through offload_log_triage, and runs offload_deep_review prior to cadence-reviewer.
assertions: Spawns a fresh isolated worktree subagent instead of resuming a zero-change subagent context
Resolves shared append-only file conflicts additively (never blind --ours/--theirs) in owning worktree
Routes post-review edits back to owning worktree rather than read-only reviewer/maintainer
Runs offload_log_triage on tests and offload_deep_review prior to cadence-reviewer
